plan.title: SRC-CRE-045 — Upload valid product sheet rows

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required before selecting the RFQ template.
Provide the mandatory event title so the create flow remains valid.
Choose the available RFQ template so the product sheet is rendered.
Select the specified product in the first Product cell.
Verify the selected product is shown in the sheet.
Verify the product automatically fills the mapped Variant 1 value.
Enter the requested quantity from the case.
Upload the available valid-row fixture as the closest catalog representation of the completed sheet file.
Verify that the uploaded sheet renders three product rows.
Confirm the upload completed without an application error.
